title: Europa League, researched picks
written: Thu 15 Oct, 17:10 (Lyon v Palace player props added after confirmed line-ups)
intro: The model's strongest legs in the eight closest games on team strength, checked against tonight's team news, line-ups and referee appointments. Kept where the research backs the model; mostly cards and rotation. Fair is the least to accept.

caveats: The model knows records and team strength, not line-ups or referees. The adjustments here are judgement from the research.
